caption: Hunebed D53, Havelte
composition: Long capstone chamber and porch on the heath north of the road · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Hunebed D53 lies on the Havelterberg north of Hunebeddenweg, a long chamber of capstones on uprights, with the porch still in place. Heath and a few trees surround the stones. D54 across the road is not in this frame, and the larger D27 at Borger is a different scene. The sky is overcast, about 8.0°C, with wind near 1.4 km/h and cloud cover about 95%.
